verdict.rationale: Supermemory offers a self-hosting option that runs entirely on the user's own hardware ('data never leaves the building'), which gives a form of control over data location, and pricing mentions SOC2/HIPAA compliance and a self-hosted tier. However, there is no evidence of an explicit region/residency selection feature for the hosted cloud product (e.g., choosing EU vs US data centers) — self-hosting is an all-or-nothing workaround rather than a granular residency control. Missing for 10: hosted multi-region data residency options, explicit region selector in dashboard/API, documentation of data center locations for the managed service.
